text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki roars after conquering the 
Satsuki Sho. Proclaiming she will win the 
Japan Derby as well, she shows immense 
determination for the second crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though Mejiro Ardan showed her 
frustration, her steps remained steady 
even after finishing the Satsuki Sho, 
speaking volumes of her growth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taking this battle as fuel to grow, she 
vows once more to achieve results in the 
Aoba Sho and the Nippon Derby beyond.
